summary: We have put in millions of dollars grants from 25K to 1.4 million to bring #DoOO to k12 schools. Any school can get involved and it is a tiny budget hit when you think about the return in digital learning and data. reach out #nctechat
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: We have put in millions of dollars grants from 25K to 1.4 million to bring #DoOO to k12 schools. Any school can get involved and it is a tiny budget hit when you think about the return in digital learning and data. reach out #nctechat
